rubrics.justification: Description is largely consistent with a hatching/expanded blastocyst and broadly matches the reported 4AA; notes on blastocoel, zona thinning/herniation, and visible cell clusters are reasonable, though some specifics like exact ICM location and TE grade are somewhat inferential from a single static image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality well; strongest omission/error is mentioning prior IVF failure despite the case stating no previous cycles.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to morphology, age, and uterine/tubal factors; minor issues include overemphasis on hydrosalpinx without confirmation and a few speculative points.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including support for single embryo transfer and attention to hydrosalpinx/cavity status; minor deviations include speculative adjuncts and some less standard future-cycle suggestions.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including SET, luteal support, cavity/tubal review, and stimulation reassessment; useful but some recommendations are broad rather than tightly protocol-specific.
